topic.title: 15 Things Every Family Did on Thanksgiving Day in the 1970s — Unthinkable Today
topic.angle: Not the food but the whole day: the parade on the console TV, the kids' table, everyone in their Sunday best, ashtrays in the living room and Dad asleep in the recliner. A full Thanksgiving day, hour by hour.
topic.why: First video in the 'Holidays in the 70s' series. Thanksgiving is Nov 26, so this is the most urgent topic. It follows the day's rituals rather than the table, which keeps it clear of the rejected 'Thanksgiving table' video. It draws on 'things we did in the 70s' and '1970s holiday nostalgia'.
